title: Find the limit that stops a run

blocks.text: A school-bus routing team replays old solver runs to choose stopping rules for next term. For each past run they kept a **trace**: the solver's progress at a few moments, oldest first. Each row is a dict with these keys:

items: `"incumbent"`: the best plan's objective value, or `None` before the first plan;

blocks.text: The model is a maximization, and every incumbent in a trace is positive.

Write `where_it_stops(trace, limits)` in `first_limit.py`. `limits` holds some of the keys `"relative_gap"`, `"absolute_gap"`, `"nodes"`, `"solutions"` and `"seconds"`. Return `(index, rule)`: the index of the first row at which a rule in `limits` is met, and that rule's key. If no rule is met on any row, return `(None, None)`.
A rule is met on a row when:

items: `"relative_gap"`: the row has an incumbent and $`(\text{bound} - \text{incumbent}) / \text{incumbent}`$ is at most the limit;
`"absolute_gap"`: the row has an incumbent and $`\text{bound} - \text{incumbent}`$ is at most the limit;
`"nodes"`, `"solutions"`, `"seconds"`: the row's value is at least the limit.

blocks.text: A row with no incumbent meets no gap rule. When several rules are met on the same row, name the first in this order: `"relative_gap"`, `"absolute_gap"`, `"nodes"`, `"solutions"`, `"seconds"`. A gap rule comes first because a solver that meets one reports the run as optimal.

cases.says: a relative gap tolerance stops the run at the first row whose gap is within it
a solution limit stops the run at the first row whose count reaches it
when a gap tolerance and a node limit are met on the same row, the gap rule is the one named
an absolute tolerance stops the run on its own, before the relative tolerance is met
a node count equal to the limit meets it
a row with no plan yet cannot meet a gap rule, however small its bound
a trace in which no rule is met gives (None, None)

origin.section: Each Limit Answers a Different Question

concepts: a solve stops at the first rule it meets, and gap rules are checked against the incumbent and bound at that moment
